pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding units to losing sequences or averaging down into micro-wicks; scale-ins only permitted after initial position achieves +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution unless the 14-period ADX is > 25 and the order direction strictly aligns with the 1-hour EMA slope, backed by a hard maximum 5.00 dollar structural stop.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation at +$10.00 profit, locking in minimum +$6.00 to force execution into the $15-$30+ asymmetric reward distribution.
